sources.topic: Group bit masks, partial lock acquisition, busy unlock codes and automatic terminal unlock

contract.context: Explicit groups in 1..31; optional supplied idle/executing/stopped labels
contract.masks: Bit n-1 selects group n; zero no-op; invalid/unconfigured mask fails before mutation
contract.owners: Stable calling-root object identity across calls and task renames; reentrant locks are idempotent
contract.partial: Lock acquires available groups; unlock releases eligible owned groups; first blocked group in ascending order supplies status
contract.bounded_waits: Independent lock_wait_ms and unlock_wait_ms enable atomic manual masks. Waits use cooperative checkpoints, exact release grants and the first blocked status on timeout.
contract.lifecycle: Pause and nested returns retain ownership. Root completion, stop, abort and failure release owned groups.
contract.persistence: Configured groups, labels and options persist. Live ownership and pending waits prevent context save.

boundaries: No native robot/servo locks, motion effects or native lock waits
Supplied motion labels do not execute or observe motion
